verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a real-time decision hook: JIT Funding sends funding requests to your system to approve or deny. It also documents merchant-based authorization controls and transaction lookup by merchant. However, no evidence describes what an authorization event payload contains: merchant name, MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode details, and partial-approval or incremental-auth signals are all unevidenced. Merchant-restriction controls and merchant-filtered queries are adjacent features, not documented event context, so they earn no credit.
